intro: Paper size and orientation are chosen at print time, in the dialog that opens before printing. This page shows this device's default format and a preview of each game type's mission report.
formatInModalNote: Format and orientation are confirmed on every print, in the print dialog - the default format is proposed there.
layoutsVersionBuiltin: No synced templates - using the built-in ones.
printerPaperNote: The report is laid out at exactly this size whatever paper the printer uses - on larger paper it prints at the correct scale instead of stretching.
